title: Verify: playSceneTransition unit tests with a mocked context
summary: Prove the fade is called with the content duration and skipped when absent.
description: Unit tests in game/tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts using a fake EffectRenderContext, mirroring game/tests/buildEffects.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts playTransition called once with 400 for a fade entry.
Test asserts playTransition not called without a transition entry.
technical_constraints: Fake context made of vi.fn(); no Phaser

steps.symbol: new: plays the authored fade with the content duration
steps.action: Build ctx = { createEffect: vi.fn(), playTransition: vi.fn() } and a scene object with effects [{ type: 'transition', kind: 'fade', durationMs: 400 }] (shape copied from the fade constant in game/tests/buildEffects.test.ts L18); call playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) and assert playTransition toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and toHaveBeenCalledWith(400).
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts

steps.symbol: new: does not play when no transition entry
steps.action: Call playSceneTransition with a scene whose effects are [{ type: 'ambientLight', color: '#1a2b3c', alpha: 0.4 }] and again with effects undefined; assert playTransition not.toHaveBeenCalled().
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts
